text_block_list.text:
One day, while hard at work training for
the upcoming GⅠ race and her revenge match
against Narita Brian...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Trainy!

Hishi Amazon barged into the Trainer's Room,
her face pale with distress.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: That Brian...!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: ""The URA has announced an injury regarding last year's Triple Crown Umamusume, Narita Brian.""

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: "She will be taking a brief hiatus, with plans to return to racing around autumn."

"The injury of Narita Brian, who was hailed as
the strongest, sent massive shockwaves through the Umamusume world."

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Narita Brian is injured, for real!?
I hope she's okay...

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
She'll be fine. She's such an amazing Umamusume.
I'm sure she'll be back in no time and put on a great race next year.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's true. Lots of girls
come back even after getting hurt...!

"Indeed, many Umamusume make brilliant comebacks
from injuries. But the reality is that just as many
have their competitive careers cut short right there."

Her current injury in particular—right hip arthritis—has a high chance of recurrence even after fully healing.
There isn't much room for optimism.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—Salt daifuku, rice crackers, and maybe I'll bring a book too.
Dumbbells... nah, let's leave those behind.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide probably got all the essentials ready,
so this should about do it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Trainee.
No gloomy faces allowed, got it?

A few days after the news of Narita Brian's injury broke,
I went with Hishi Amazon
to visit her in the hospital.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I figured people would come, but...
this is an incredible amount of get-well gifts.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What's the problem? Bigger is better, right!
More importantly, how are you feeling?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone's making too much of a fuss.
Come autumn, I'll be back racing.

Hearing those clear words straight from her,
Hishi Amazon's expression brightened up a bit.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
Heh, well that's good to hear.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: To be honest, I even ended up wondering if you were completely crushed by it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: An unnecessary worry.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, one look at your face and I knew for sure.
Well, in that case, there's only one thing to say!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Make sure you heal up before the next Arima Kinen! We'll be waiting!

Hishi Amazon made her spirited declaration,
and Narita Brian stared intently at her face.

After a brief stay in the hospital,
Narita Brian was discharged.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: "I'll be waiting," huh...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey! I was wondering where you wandered off to!
You just got discharged, so stop wandering around so much!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...I have wondered for a while now.
Why are you so fixated on me?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh? Where'd that come from all of a sudden?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: "She said it when she came to visit me, too. 'I'll be waiting at the Arima Kinen.' Why?"

Faced with such a direct question,
Hishi Amazon looked up into the air, searching for words.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well...
...it's because going one-on-one with you is an absolute thrill.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Running beside her gives me chills. I can sense the beast within her.
So no matter how far away her back gets—"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It just makes me think...
someday, I'm gonna overtake her.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
S-say something, Brian!
It's kind of embarrassing, you know!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...The back I want to surpass, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...I have it too.
I finally understand. About Ama-san.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I won't stop running. Don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah...! Hey, where are you going?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hold onto the handrail when you go down!
Hey! Are you listening to me?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...And that's what happened.
Good grief, acting all nonchalant as always.
choice_data_list: Glad to see you're doing well.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Well, that's true.
Doesn't seem like she's letting it get to her too much."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I was a bit curious when you mentioned wanting to surpass someone's back...
Well, it'd be bad manners to pry.
Everyone's got their own stuff going on, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "Either way, we've only got one thing to do! We're gonna train our butts off before winter hits!"
Perhaps reassured by seeing that Narita Brian hadn't changed at all, they seemed to regain their spirits.
